entries.title: LibreOffice Headless Fallback for Legacy Office Formats
entries.claim_source: src/content/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md — PDF and Office Document Text Extraction section
entries.expected: Spawn soffice --headless to convert legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt to text in a sandboxed subprocess (posix_spawn, restricted OS user, 30 s timeout)
entries.observed: Not implemented; no soffice/posix_spawn usage found in office_processor.cpp
evidence: src/content/ROADMAP.md Known Issues: 'Legacy Office formats (DOC/XLS/PPT via OLE/Compound Document) not fully supported'
entries.impact: Legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt files cannot be extracted; only OOXML (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX) and ODF are handled
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): implement LibreOffice headless fallback in office_processor.cpp for legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt

entries.title: MimeDetector-Triggered OCR via ContentPolicy
entries.expected: MimeDetector triggers OCR for image/png, image/jpeg, image/tiff when ContentPolicy::ocrEnabled() == true for the collection
entries.observed: No ocrEnabled() method found on ContentPolicy; MimeDetector does not trigger OCR routing
entries.impact: OCR is not automatically triggered during ingestion; must be invoked manually via ocr_processor.cpp
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): add ContentPolicy::ocrEnabled() and wire OCR trigger in MimeDetector

entries.title: OCR Pre-Processing: DPI Rescaling to 300 DPI
entries.expected: Rescale images to 300 DPI before OCR if metadata indicates lower resolution; apply adaptive binarisation via Leptonica
entries.observed: Leptonica used for image loading (line 145); no DPI rescaling logic found
evidence: src/content/ocr_processor.cpp — grep for 'rescale', '300', 'dpi', 'binariz' returns no results
entries.impact: OCR quality on low-resolution scans may be degraded; no pre-processing normalisation
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): add 300-DPI rescaling and adaptive binarisation in ocr_processor.cpp

entries.title: OCR Language Pack Path Not Constrained to config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/
entries.expected: Language packs loaded from config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/; default eng; configurable per-collection
entries.observed: config_.data_dir is user-provided with no default value pointing to config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/; language pack path is not constrained
evidence: src/content/ocr_processor.cpp:132 — 'const char* data_dir = config_.data_dir.empty() ? nullptr : config_.data_dir.c_str()'
entries.impact: Inconsistent deployment — operators must know the path; no convention-over-configuration
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): default ocr_processor data_dir to config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/ via ConfigPathResolver

entries.title: Streaming Ingestion Back-Pressure Not Implemented
entries.expected: ingestStream() blocks the caller when the worker queue depth exceeds config_.max_queue_depth; returns a std::future<ContentId> for async callers
entries.observed: Back-pressure item is still [ ] open in FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md
evidence: src/content/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md line ~69: '[ ] Back-pressure: ingestStream() blocks the caller...'
entries.impact: Under high ingestion load the worker queue can grow unbounded; callers are not throttled
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): implement back-pressure in async_ingestion_worker.cpp for ingestStream()

entries.title: Zip-Bomb Protection Missing in archive_processor.cpp
entries.expected: content_security.cpp scans all uploaded archives for zip-bomb patterns; enforce max decompressed-to-compressed ratio of 100× and max extracted file count of 1,000
evidence: src/content/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md: '[ ] content_security.cpp must scan all uploaded archives (ZIP, tar) for zip-bomb patterns'
entries.impact: Maliciously crafted ZIP/tar archives could exhaust memory or disk during extraction
entries.issue_title_suggestion: fix(content/security): add zip-bomb protection in archive_processor.cpp via content_security.cpp

entries.title: LibreOffice Subprocess Must Use posix_spawn with Restricted User
entries.expected: LibreOffice headless subprocess runs under a restricted OS user with no write access to ThemisDB data dir; uses posix_spawn instead of system()
entries.observed: LibreOffice fallback not yet implemented (see CON-001); security constraint must be applied when CON-001 is implemented
evidence: src/content/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md: '[ ] LibreOffice headless subprocess ... must run in a separate OS user ... use posix_spawn'
entries.impact: If LibreOffice fallback is added without sandboxing, a malicious document could compromise the ThemisDB data directory
entries.issue_title_suggestion: fix(content/security): ensure LibreOffice subprocess in office_processor.cpp uses posix_spawn with restricted user
